title: Silent Magician: Yugi's Silent Duo (lore build)
summary: Silent Magician is Yugi's level-up magician, and on its own it has no in-theme way to start. So this list pairs it with its twin from Yugi's deck, Silent Swordsman. The 2024 "Zero" versions of both come in too, with the Shining Sarcophagus Spells whose art shows them.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: Silent Magician Zero and Silent Swordsman Zero, the newest (2024): they grow when the opponent draws or each Standby Phase, and negate while you control Shining Sarcophagus.
Silent Magician and Silent Swordsman (2016), which float into their LV8 and LV7 forms when destroyed, plus the original LV lines.
Silent Paladin, the Fairy that searches both LV starters.
Shining Sarcophagus and the Spells drawn with the Silent duo: Ties That Bind shows the Zeros, Future Silence the old Magician and Turn Silence the old Swordsman.

summary.title: How it plays
points: Shining Sarcophagus searches Ties That Bind, which summons both Zeros from the Deck at once. Future Silence searches a Zero and refills both hands to six in the Battle Phase.
Normal Summon a Zero, then tribute it for Silent Magician (a Spellcaster) or Silent Swordsman (a Warrior). Those negate a Spell each turn and, when destroyed, summon their LV8 or LV7 form.
Silent Burning and Silent Sword Slash banish themselves to search the next Silent monster. Level Up! moves an LV monster straight to its next form.
Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter isn't released in the TCG.
